cases.name: buffered_accept
cases.assertion: try writech on nonfull buffered channel returns Accepted and transfers exactly one value

cases.name: buffered_full
cases.assertion: try writech on full channel returns Full(original) without enqueue or waiter

cases.name: closed_write
cases.assertion: try writech after close returns Closed(original), never false or an untyped exception

cases.name: close_vs_write
cases.assertion: racing close and immediate write yields one linearizable outcome, never double-drop

cases.name: capacity_zero_unmatched
cases.assertion: unbuffered try writech without ready reader returns Full(original)

cases.name: capacity_zero_matched
cases.assertion: unbuffered try writech with armed reader commits exactly one rendezvous

cases.name: racing_writers
cases.assertion: racing writers admit no more than capacity and return every losing owned payload

cases.name: retry_after_full
cases.assertion: Full(payload) may be retried and is admitted exactly once after capacity opens

cases.name: explicit_take_accepted
cases.assertion: take! source is invalid after Accepted; channel has one owner

cases.name: explicit_take_rejected
cases.assertion: take! source remains invalid after Full/Closed, recovered value exists only in result

cases.name: borrow_and_guard_denial
cases.assertion: borrowed references, MutexGuard and non-transportable capabilities fail static admission

cases.name: actor_isolation_denial
cases.assertion: untrusted actor/private pointer channel escape is rejected

cases.name: probe_leaves_no_waiter
cases.assertion: no waiter or deferred send remains after Full or Closed

cases.name: read_some_none_closed
cases.assertion: try readch yields Some or None; closed and drained raises closed failure

cases.name: nb_differs_from_try
cases.assertion: nb writech arms a Future and try writech never arms a Future

cases.name: select_atomicity
cases.assertion: immediate writes arbitrate with select and pending reads without double commit

cases.name: source_eval_once
cases.assertion: channel and payload evaluated once; result corresponds to same probe

cases.name: drop_safety
cases.assertion: move-only payload is neither leaked nor double-dropped across every result branch
